title: Reduce Test Project Warning Noise
description: Clean up test-project warnings blocking signal/noise by fixing nullable client usage, analyzer recommendations, and SQL query parameterization warnings.

tasks.title: Eliminate warnings in test files
acceptance_criteria: AuthFlowIntegrationTests has no CS8604 client-null warnings
IngredientListApiIntegrationTests has no CS8602/CS8604 client-null warnings
IngredientListSchemaTests no longer triggers EF1002 SqlQueryRaw warning
tasks.notes: Updated nullable client/factory access in AuthFlowIntegrationTests and IngredientListApiIntegrationTests to use non-null helper properties, replaced Assert.ThrowsExceptionAsync with Assert.ThrowsExactlyAsync in AuthApiClientTests, and made schema table existence query explicitly parameterized with SqlQueryRaw placeholders. dotnet build RecipeManager.Tests/RecipeManager.Tests.csproj succeeds with no warnings.

dependencies: Do not alter production runtime behavior
